# Patch the stan/plugins.py file
import sys

# Read the file
with open('/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/stan/plugins.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Replace pkg_resources with importlib.metadata
content = content.replace(
    'import pkg_resources',
    'try:\n    import pkg_resources\nexcept ImportError:\n    from importlib import metadata as pkg_resources\n    # Create a compatibility layer\n    class pkg_resources:\n        class EntryPoint:\n            def __init__(self, name, value):\n                self.name = name\n                self.value = value\n        def iter_entry_points(group):\n            return []'
)

# Write back
with open('/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/stan/plugins.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Patched stan/plugins.py")

async def check_httpstan():
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        # Try to get the version
        try:
            async with session.get('http://localhost:8080/version') as resp:
                print("Status:", resp.status)
                text = await resp.text()
                print("Response:", text[:500])
        except Exception as e:
            print("Error:", e)
